subject: aceEditor: unable to provide custom completion candidates with autoCompleteList

messages.author: a417fa537bba98f2
messages.subject: aceEditor: unable to provide custom completion candidates with autoCompleteList
parts:
Dear all,

I am integrating a tagging system in my shinyapp and I would like the users to be able to "easily" reuse these tags in an aceEditor through auto-completion.

Running the example below it appears that the candidates are extracted from the "value" parameter (pressing "s" will prompt you with "see" and "yourself", pressing "f" will prompt you with "for" and "yourself") while I was expecting the elements from the "autoCompleteList" parameter to be candidates (pressing "s" would prompt you with "setosa" and "versicolor", pressing "f" will prompt you with nothing...yet)

library(shiny)
library(shinyAce)
shinyUI(
      aceEditor(outputId = "myAutocompletableEditor",
                value = "see for yourself...",
                mode="plain_text",
                autoComplete="live",
                autoCompleteList=list(species=c("setosa", "versicolor", "virginica")))
  )

Am I misunderstanding the purpose of autoCompleteList or am I just doing it wrong?

Thanks in advance for any help :)

Bastien
